title: dactylorchis majalis var. brevicalcarata
intro: Dactylorchis majalis var. brevicalcarata, commonly known as a type of orchid, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve fever, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids.
